release_notes:
ReadySetPDF 4.0.10

Grid is now Grid / Bleeds. Grow Bleed adds bleed to pages that have none. Quick grow scales the artwork onto the larger page. Edge extend keeps the artwork in place and fills the new band by mirroring or stretching the outer edge. The original page is saved as the TrimBox, so Grid and Booklet pack on the finished size and crop marks land on the original edge.

Details lists every font and no longer cuts a long report short.

Buttons across the panels match the rounded header buttons, and the label shrinks so it stays inside the button.

Arrange Pages shows the whole page, and its section dividers can be dragged.

Some customer PDFs no longer hang while the preview is building.

The Mail Merge hint wraps to the width of the pane.
